text: No, I haven't noticed any weight loss or night sweats. As for my work history, I was a construction worker for many years, so I might have had some exposure to dust and silica, though I don't recall wearing a respirator consistently. speaker: Doctor
text:
I understand your concern, but your stable vital signs and lack of fever make sepsis highly unlikely at this stage. The combination of a six-week cough, restrictive lung function, and significant silica exposure from your construction work strongly points to a specific occupational lung disease.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Silicosis
